content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Alexandra Johnson (E003)
Requested: admin access to Source Code

Facts:
- Role: Analyst
- Employment type: contractor
- Security training: basic

Access policy:
1. Full-time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system.
2. Contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

Source Code is owned by Engineer role. Alexandra is an Analyst contractor with basic security training.

So maximum allowed: read (contractor, no advanced training, and never admin).

Requested: admin. Above maximum. Grant maximum = read.

The recommendation from both notes: read.

So decision: read.
